Who we are

Food as a force for good

Seacoles is named in honour of Mary Seacole — the pioneering Jamaican-British nurse who fed and cared for those others overlooked. We carry that spirit into everything we cook.

From our base at Kath Locke Centre in Moss Side, we serve the local community and reach businesses and events across Greater Manchester — bringing Caribbean warmth and skill to every plate.

Catering & Events

Your event, our flavours

We cater for everything from intimate family occasions to large corporate events. Bespoke menus, professional service, and the same commitment to quality that defines our café every day.

Our Story

Named for a pioneer.
Built for the community.

Seacoles takes its name from Mary Seacole — the Jamaican-British nurse who pioneered care and comfort for those others overlooked. Her spirit lives in everything we cook.

Seacoles Group was founded by Otis Thomas with a clear purpose: to bring high-quality, community-centred food enterprise to Manchester's neighbourhoods — and to demonstrate that Caribbean food businesses can be professional, profitable, and deeply rooted in the communities they serve.

Operating from Kath Locke Centre in Moss Side, our café has become a daily fixture for the local community — a warm, welcoming space where people come for breakfast, lunch, and everything in between.

Under the leadership of CEO Simon Smith, we've grown from a single café operation into a full-service catering enterprise, pitching and winning contracts across Greater Manchester while remaining firmly rooted in the grassroots community work that started it all.

"We're not just feeding people. We're building something that belongs to the community — economically, culturally, spiritually."

Our menus draw on the rich traditions of Caribbean and African-Caribbean cooking — slow-braised meats, aromatic rice dishes, bold spicing, fresh vibrant salads — updated for modern tastes and dietary needs without losing the soul of the original.

We're proud to be a Black-owned, community-first enterprise in a city that celebrates its diversity. Every meal we serve is a statement that great food and social purpose can go hand in hand.

The café

A proper local

Seacoles Café at Kath Locke Centre is more than a place to eat — it's a community hub. We serve breakfast and lunch five days a week, with a rotating menu of daily specials, £5 deals, and made-from-scratch Caribbean food.

Whether you're a regular or visiting for the first time, you'll find familiar faces, good food, and a space that genuinely welcomes everyone.

Catering Services

We'll bring the food.
You bring the occasion.

Bespoke catering for events of all sizes across Greater Manchester. From intimate family celebrations to large corporate dinners.

Corporate

Workplace & Corporate

Staff lunches, business meetings, client hospitality, office parties, and team events. Flexible formats including buffets, served meals, and grazing tables.

Celebrations

Weddings & Celebrations

Weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, christenings. We build bespoke menus around your vision, dietary needs, and budget.

Community

Community Events

Fairs, markets, conferences, cultural events. We have experience at large-scale community occasions including the 422 Community Hub.

What we offer

A full-service catering experience

🍽 Bespoke Menus

We build menus around your event, guests, and dietary requirements. Caribbean signatures or broader fusion menus — your call.

🚐 Full Delivery & Setup

We transport, set up, serve, and clear away — leaving you free to enjoy the occasion with your guests.

♿ Dietary & Allergen Aware

Full allergen information, vegetarian and vegan options, halal-friendly menus. We cater for everyone at your table.

📋 Contract Catering

Ongoing workplace or community contracts. Reliable, professional daily catering at scale, with the quality of a restaurant kitchen.
